# Sector KPI proofs

Source evidence remains the unchanged Part 2 YESBANK consolidated and INFY standalone HTML.
`expected_inputs.json` is a separately inspected selection of its March 2024/2025 cells.
`expected_outputs.json` is independent literal truth; never regenerate it from production output.
Existing Part 4A arithmetic expectations are reused unchanged for semantically identical formulas.

User-locked deposit growth: (284420/266230-1)*100 = 1819000/266230 percent.
User-locked operating-margin change uses all FOUR observations, without rounding margins:
(33499/136592 - 31757/128933)*10000 = -186255770000/17611216336 basis points.
This exact fraction was hand-specified and independently divided at 50 digits before KPI code.
Its display is -10.58 bps; using 24.52 and 24.63 would incorrectly give -11 bps.
INFY EPS: (61.56-65.61)/65.61*100 = -40500/6561 percent.
All rational fractions compare exactly; Decimal outputs use the recorded 50-digit HALF_EVEN
representation, not a tolerance. Expected and actual output reporting is separate from these files.

`legacy_4a_snapshot.json` is a byte-for-byte serialization compatibility fixture copied from the
previous local Part 4A proof BEFORE Part 4C changes. It is not an arithmetic golden generated by
this implementation. Tests load its old, unwrapped schema 4.1 payload without updating its row.
